notes.text: Matched displayed institution-scoped accession VI 4905 and the complete 89 x 7,5 x 9 cm dimensions with the IndiGen entry; type and provenance were also compared. IndiGen calls this object Ua; the museum calls it paoa / Keule. Both accounts are retained. Selective transcription of the displayed catalogue fields; participant roles and acquisition wording remain contextual descriptions, and geographical associations are not treated as making-place claims.
